evals.name: retry-on-transient-error

assertions.text: uses MockLanguageModelV4 from 'ai/test'
throws APICallError with isRetryable: true from ai
returns a content array with a { type: 'text', text: ... } part
finishReason is an object with unified field, not a bare string
uses model.doGenerateCalls.length to sequence a throwing response without a separate manual counter
asserts model was called exactly twice
does NOT use obsolete 'rawCall' field
does NOT use V2 'textDelta' field

evals.name: stream-tool-call-with-input-deltas
evals.prompt: Write a node:test integration test that uses `ai/test` to mock a model that STREAMS a tool call with progressively streamed tool-input arguments (the Anthropic-style input streaming pattern). The test should verify that a tool called 'search' ends up with a final input of {"query":"weather"} after streaming. Use streamText. Don't actually run the tool — just assert that the tool call arrived with the right parsed input. Show me a complete, runnable test file.

assertions.text: uses simulateReadableStream from 'ai'
emits tool-input-start chunk with id and toolName
emits tool-input-delta chunks with delta field (not textDelta)
emits tool-input-end chunk
emits final tool-call chunk with stringified JSON input
emits finish chunk with finishReason object and unified: 'tool-calls'
does NOT include obsolete rawCall field in the doStream return value
matching ids across tool-input-start/delta/end and tool-call

evals.name: v7-prebuilt-migration-with-unique-validator
evals.prompt: Review an AI SDK test helper module after upgrading to ai@7. It currently uses MockLanguageModelV3, a hand-written sequential-value closure, a hand-written deterministic ID counter, a custom ReadableStream collector, and a JSON chunk validator that checks start/delta/end ordering and matching IDs. Rewrite or remove helpers where AI SDK v7 already provides an equivalent, use only the current V4 provider protocol, and preserve any behavior for which ai/test has no public equivalent. Explain each keep/replace/remove decision with the exact installed export or source behavior that supports it.

assertions.text: uses only V4 model mocks and V4 provider types in resulting examples
replaces sequential-value closure with mockValues where no throwing behavior is required
replaces deterministic ID counter with mockId
replaces custom stream collection with convertReadableStreamToArray
imports simulateReadableStream from ai rather than its deprecated ai/test re-export
preserves the semantic JSON chunk validator because ai/test has no public ordering or matching-ID validator
does not claim all V4 modality mocks capture calls; only language and embedding mocks do
verifies array-backed language-model responses return index 0 on the first call
